{\it (i)} the binding energy dependence of nuclear shadowing is weak and can only be observed in the case of very small nuclei; {\it (ii)} the binding energy of a nucleus affects the nuclear structure functions at $x\mathrel{\rlap{\lower4pt\hbox{$\sim$}}\raise1.0pt\hbox{${\scriptstyle <}$}} 10^{-3}$; {\it (iii)} in a kinematic regime where
the binding effects in the nuclear structure functions are not large, and that they are of the same order of magnitude as the effects of shadowing.
the binding effect is small at high $x$ and that it is not negligible at low $x$.
